title: Fully cover and verify one region; reach ≥95% audit accuracy
context: The M2 milestone requires at least one region to be fully covered and audited at ≥95% accuracy and ≥90% freshness — the metrics that determine whether the directory is safe to rely on for referrals. Expanding from the M0 pilot (~25–50 entries) to full regional coverage requires the complete ingestion, geocoding, deduplication, and verification pipeline from M1 to be operational. Depends on food-maps-geocode-008, food-maps-fresh-009, and food-maps-verify-010.
objective: Using the M1 pipeline (adapters, geocoder, dedup, staleness machine, verification-log gate), ingest, verify, and publish a complete food-assistance directory for one defined region (city/county or metropolitan area). Every published entry must clear the verification + freshness + license + PII gates. Conduct or commission a random-sample re-verification audit of the published entries and demonstrate ≥95% accuracy (existence, location, hours, eligibility) and ≥90% freshness within SLA.
acceptanceCriteria: One region is defined (city, county, or metropolitan area) with a coverage boundary documented
All food-assistance service types in scope (food banks, pantries, community fridges, soup kitchens, meal programs) within the region are ingested from cleared sources
Every published entry clears the verification policy (one authoritative source or ≥2 independent signals) with last_verified within the freshness SLA
Every published entry has a correct per-record data_license; no ODbL-derived entry is relabeled CC-BY
Every published entry has pii_review recorded; operator-PII minimized where applicable

A random-sample re-verification audit (≥10% of entries, conducted by a reviewer independent of the ingester) measures accuracy on: existence (site is open), location (correct address), hours (correct current hours), and eligibility (correct eligibility criteria)
Audit result shows ≥95% accuracy across audited entries
Freshness report shows ≥90% of regional entries within the freshness SLA at the time of publication
Closed/moved sites are recorded with correct operating_status and not published as active
A PR-tied verification-log entry covers the full regional dataset
output: data/<region>/ (complete regional dataset in HSDS-conformant JSON) + docs/verification-log.md (regional audit entry) + docs/audit-report-<region>.md (random-sample accuracy audit results).
